correctness.rationale: From period-two stock conservation, a+b=2c and s1-s0=(b-a)/2. Response updates force s1-s0=b/h(a)-a/h(b), which is >b-a if b>a, using nondecrease and 0<h<1. Swapping indices excludes a>b. Equality gives a fixed point; all boundary states map into the interior. Smooth decreasing logistic sharpness follows by exact logit and rational arithmetic. All quantifiers, including discontinuous nondecreasing h, are covered.

value.rationale: Natural local period-two resonance is rigorously excluded throughout all replenishment parameters and all monotone feedbacks, including the oscillatory Neimark–Sacker regime motivating spatial spirals. An exact smooth logistic period-two witness when monotonicity is reversed isolates the structural mechanism. This globally excludes a nontrivial dynamical possibility without implying absence of higher-period or quasiperiodic oscillations.
